coverage_source_label: Virginia Department of Elections, registered voters by House and Senate district and precinct (current districts drawn by the Supreme Court of Virginia, Dec. 2021, first used 2023)
registrations_rule: Counted: committees on the Nov. 2027 cycle, not closed, with a residence inside the seat and a 2027 signal (registered in 2026 or later, a 2026 Statement of Organization naming 2027, money raised on a 2026 report, or the seat's current officeholder). Committees the Department of Elections carried forward from earlier races with none of these are not counted.
